title: Luana Lopes Lara built Kalshi into a $40 billion prediction market giant; now faces US gambling law battle
summary_full: Luana Lopes Lara, 30, became the world's youngest self-made female billionaire after co-founding Kalshi with Tarek Mansour in 2021. The prediction market platform is now valued at $40 billion. Known for working up to 16 hours a day, Lara built the company through years of regulatory battles. Now, Kalshi faces legal challenges over whether its event contracts violate US state gambling laws.
